# National Scaffold

> England's fixed-price scaffolding network, connecting customers with vetted professional scaffolding contractors for residential and commercial projects. No hidden charges — the price agreed upfront is the price you pay.

National Scaffold operates across London and England, matching enquiries to a vetted panel of scaffolding contractors and providing a single fixed price quote per job, covering roofing, chimney, extension, gutter/fascia and general access scaffolding.

## Services
- [Residential Scaffolding](https://nationalscaffold.co.uk/residential-scaffolding.html): Fixed price scaffolding for homes, including roofing, gutters, chimneys and extensions
- [Commercial Scaffolding](https://nationalscaffold.co.uk/commercial-scaffolding.html): Fixed price scaffolding for offices, retail units, industrial sites and new builds
- [Contractors](https://nationalscaffold.co.uk/contractors.html): Join the vetted network of scaffolding contractors across England
- [Locations](https://nationalscaffold.co.uk/locations.html): Full directory of areas and services covered across England
